SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE/REQUEST FOR INFORMATION

NOTICE: FA4613SSSTARVENTS- Replace Storm Damage Historic Vents Multi Bldgs

1. This is a Source Sought announcement. North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) of 236220 Commercial and Institutional Building Construction with a small business size standard of $45 Million is to be used for market analysis only to determine the availability of potential small business categories for potential set-asides. No Award will be made from this sources sought. No solicitation is available at this time. All responses will be used to determine the appropriate acquisition strategy for future acquisition.

2. F.E. Warren AFB, Wyoming is conducting market research to identify potential sources that possess the expertise, capabilities, and experience in completing the following requirement:

Replace Storm Damage Historic Star Vents Multi Bldgs at FE Warren AFB, Wyoming. Intention is to create a one time, firm fixed price contract. Please see attached SOW for more information.

3. All interested parties are invited to send a capability statement that will briefly describe how your company can satisfy the requirement described above to: megan.evans.3@us.af.mil and liezel.mcintyre@us.af.mil. Please ensure your capability statement includes:

(a) Company Name and CAGE Code Number

(b) Mailing Address

(c) Point of Contact to include phone number and e-mail

(d) Website, if applicable

(e) State whether your campny is small, 8(a), VOSB, SDVOSB, HUBZone small business, SDB, WOSB, etc.

5. THIS NOTICE FOR A SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTATION, PROPOSAL OR INVITATION FOR BID.

6. Any questions related to this market research should eb sent electronically to the above e-mail addresses. NO PHONE INQUIRIES PLEASE.
